correctness.rationale: The exact invertible sweep matrix is determined by triangular input/output equations. A monic elimination gives a 3-by-3 determinant, evaluated in all four rim congruence classes. Eigenvalue-one rank and derivative ranks, plus characteristic multiplicity, prove the exceptional Jordan chains; all other eigenspaces have dimension at most one. The resulting binary polynomial modules prove the exact fixed-power census for all n>=4 and d>=1. Independently implemented finite tests cover 22 determinants, 77 minimal polynomials, 1078 fixed-power ranks and all 4064 labelled states in n=4..10. The finite checks corroborate but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The natural hub-coupled extension of a sequential Rule 150 ring has a nontrivial four-residue structural transition from cyclic to three-generator modules, with exactly two extra one-dimensional fixed summands. This yields a complete infinite-family temporal-orbit census and an explicit new graph-dependent obstruction. It is neither a textbook substitution nor a restatement of existing ring or synchronous wheel counts.
